title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging in a Time-varying Hierarchical Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2610.13588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification for electric vehicle (EV) charging demand is essential to turn the increasing pressure of EV adoption on power systems into a source of flexibility. We study a large-scale dataset of public charging stations in Scotland, where demand exhibits a hierarchical structure, organized across multiple aggregation levels, from individual charging points to regional and national scales. The charging infrastructure is continuously evolving, with new stations deployed and existing ones occasionally removed, which calls for forecasting and uncertainty quantification methods tailored to this evolving structure. To address these challenges, we combine hierarchical forecasting with recent advances in conformal prediction with missing data. translated_title: 时变分层基础设施中电动汽车充电的概率预测
translated_abstract: 对电动汽车（EV）充电需求进行不确定性量化，对于将电动汽车普及给电力系统带来的日益增长的压力转化为灵活性来源至关重要。我们研究了苏格兰公共充电站的一个大规模数据集，其中需求呈现出分层结构，跨越多个聚合层级组织，从单个充电点到区域和国家级尺度。充电基础设施在不断演变，新站点不断部署，现有站点偶尔被移除，这就需要针对这种演变结构量身定制的预测和不确定性量化方法。为了应对这些挑战，我们将分层预测与处理缺失数据的保形预测最新进展相结合。所考虑的保形方法在层次结构的每个节点上都能产生有效的预测区间，其中CP-MNR-Nested算法成功地处理了时变的分层结构。
tldr: 提出将分层预测与处理缺失数据的保形预测相结合，在持续演化的电动汽车充电基础设施分层结构中，为从单个充电点到国家级的每个聚合节点生成有效的预测区间。
en_tdlr: This paper combines hierarchical forecasting with conformal prediction for missing data to produce valid prediction intervals at every node of an evolving hierarchical EV charging infrastructure, using a large-scale dataset of public charging stations in Scotland.
